# @amelhede/rppg-web (test build of @elata-biosciences/rppg-web 0.14.0): context for tools and agents

Test build: six heart-rate fixes, three speed changes and a real-pulse check, each behind a switch, all ON by default (`fixes`, `pulseCheck`, `pulseCheckRules` on `createRppgSession`). Install with an npm alias so imports stay `@elata-biosciences/rppg-web`. See README "Switches".

## Role
Browser **rPPG** (camera photoplethysmography): WASM backend, optional MediaPipe face ROI, BPM / metrics. **Primary entrypoint: `createRppgSession()`**. Higher-level UI/gating: **`createRppgAppAdapter()`**, **`createRppgAppMonitor()`**; auto-retry failures: **`createManagedRppgSession()`**. Lower-level: **`RppgProcessor`**, **`DemoRunner`**, frame sources.

## Requirements
- **Node.js >= 20** for tooling. Browser: WebAssembly; camera via `getUserMedia` where applicable.
- Published tarball includes **`dist/`** and **`pkg/`** (WASM). Local **`file:`** installs copy disk at install time: run `build:wasm` in the repo **before** installing if `pkg/` is missing.

## Critical: WASM loading (especially Vite)
Default loader fetches **`/pkg/rppg_wasm.js`** and **`.wasm`**. If the backend never loads, **`backendMode` is `"unavailable"`**, the engine's own rate never comes (with `pulseCheck: false`, **`metrics.bpm` stays null**; with the pulse check on, its rate can still come), **`onError`** fires with code **`backend_init_failed`** (URLs tried in `session.lastError.message`), and **`getState()`** reads `degraded`. With `backend: "wasm"` the session throws instead.

Fixes (see README): copy `node_modules/.../rppg-web/pkg/` to **`public/pkg/`**, or use **`wasmImporter`** with a static import of `pkg/rppg_wasm.js`, or **`wasmJsUrl` / `wasmBinaryUrl`** with Vite **`?url`** imports. Vite 7 may block dynamic imports from `/public`: do not assume copying to `public/` is enough without the README patterns.

## Pulse check
- `pulseCheck` (on by default): a rate is reported only while forehead and both cheeks prove one pulse; `session.getPulseCheck()` shows its state.
- `pulseCheckRules`, each on unless set to false (`getBuildSwitches()` reports them): `wallBandEdge`, `lightFamily`, `faceFlicker`, `lightTaint`, `headMotion` (needs MediaPipe's face mesh, 468 or 478 points, on every frame; without it no rate is shown), `darkWall` (damaged colour is read as green minus the wall only over a wall that shows the light on the face: at least a tenth as bright as the face through nearly the whole window, on any colour scale).

## Session behavior
- Expect **20 to 40 s** of a still, lit face before the first BPM (the pulse check shows a rate only once the face regions agree on it); meanwhile diagnostics often include **`insufficient_window`**.
- Check **`diagnostics.state`**, **`backendMode`**, and **`faceTrackingMode`** (`face_mesh` vs `video_frame` when `faceMesh: "auto"`).
- ROI behavior is versioned and composable. Omit `roiGeometryProfile` and `roiPixelSampler` for existing SDK behavior. Use `MCD_PROXY_INPUT_V1_PROFILE` only for the frozen model-input geometry, `TRADELOCK_LIVE_FOREHEAD_V1_PROFILE` for live-pipeline replay, and `TRADELOCK_RGB_WEIGHTED_V1_PIXEL_SAMPLER` for TradeLock pixel-selection replay. Do not treat those two geometry profiles as interchangeable.
- `sampleRppgRoi()` produces `elata.rppg.roi-sample/v1`, including raw and compatibility skin fractions plus geometry/sampler IDs for traceability.
- Bayesian ambiguity penalties are off by default. Opt in with a validated `elata.rppg.bpm-tracker-config/v1`; diagnostics expose the config ID and applied penalty.
- External evidence-quality models belong behind `BpmEvidenceQualityProvider`; SDK bounds all outputs and treats failures as neutral.
- Waveform reconstruction is diagnostic and opt-in through `experimental.waveformReconstructor`; it remains off the frame path and cannot feed BPM (`useReconstructedBpmEvidence` only accepts `false`).
- `extractWaveformMorphology()` exposes gated, source-labelled cycle features; any physiological trend proxy remains under `experimentalProxies`.
- `normalizePhysiologyFeatures()` has no labels. `createPhysiologyInterpreter()` adds generic policy-free states; its activation score is distinct from face affect, emotional valence, stress, and clinical interpretation.

## Related
If a project uses both **`rppg-web`** and **`eeg-web`**, prefer **matching published versions** unless release notes say otherwise.

## Source of truth
https://github.com/AMelhede/elata-bio-sdk/tree/release/test-1/packages/rppg-web (upstream: https://github.com/Elata-Biosciences/elata-bio-sdk)

Experimental, off by default: `experimentalVitals: true` on createRppgSession hands over HRV and breathing (from chest and shoulder motion below the chin) in their own box, `session.getExperimentalVitals()` returns `{ experimental: true, hrvRmssd, breathing }` or null. For research and testing, not measurements. Separate from `respiration_rate`, which stays withheld with the pulse check on.
